title: Wilma B NDE 9141
content: My mother died and left her body during or shortly after WWII, which was before I was born. On passing into the next heaven, she was met by two angels. They told her it was not her time and she was being sent back. Her purpose was to have three more children; she had 2 children already. They told her one child would be a Male who would be taken before the Most High. She told me this during one of our short conversations about her life. My mother probably would have been perceived as more religious before it. I perceived her as a positive, gifted, and intuitive woman who attracted other women to and around her. She did not seem to fit into church-type settings, but was more spiritually sensitive than religious; yet she maintained a strong faith in God. My mother could not possibly have told anyone about her experience, not even my father. If she had, I cannot imagine this never being discussed within the family. Certainly no one would have imagined it would be me that was mentioned in her experience. They probably would not even believe it. I never heard anything about this story within my family growing up and later in life. She may have been afraid or ashamed to speak about it, having been brought up in a very religious home. She said she had committed suicide by taking an overdose of sleeping pills. In her late 80's, being extremely frail and going into dementia, she was sent to me to be cared for. When I picked her up at the plane and wheeled her down to get the luggage, she wanted to tip me because she thought I was the bellhop. I asked her if she recognized me, her son, a few times over the next few months but she would become confused and could not answer. She treated me as if she thought I was an aid, hotel employee or just a caregiver during that time. She often thought she was staying at a hotel and would get stuck paying a big bill. For this reason, I was careful to not confuse her or create anxiety. She soon went further into dementia and had to be placed in a home for her safety and care. There never was an opportunity for me to tell her that the prophecy had been fulfilled. I never mentioned to anyone that I had that STE experience when I was 20 years old up to that time my mom came to me, other than one close friend and a pastor of a church I knew. That seemed to cool the friendship off and the pastor stood up and walked out of my home before I finished telling my experience. The first time I publicly spoke about my STE experience was in 2008 on the NDERF site. I never thought to tell my mom's side of the story at that time, as it was her story not mine. Recently, I read a NDE where the daughter was sharing her deceased mom's NDE. I realized I should tell her story too, as it may help others connect things up that God has many ways to get our attention. This is about something much bigger and universal than our earthly mind can comprehend. I originally found the NDERF site after coming to the place of realizing that there is just no way that I could be the only person on earth to have experienced what I did and I needed to find others like me. I am no one special. I am sure many religions would say I do not even measure up to their standards. Life has not been easy either, especially the feeling like I did not fit in anywhere. Everything was pretty much upside down and inside out here compared to the LOVE and ONE-ness I experienced in God's presence. I can understand now looking back that I was just getting my life 'contract agreement' experiences that I needed to have here in this 'earth suit' so I could choose to master the lessons I signed up for. It's 50 years later and I am just now getting the understanding of what my life 'purpose' is for this 'autumn' time of my life. My mom's NDE prophecy was fulfilled August 1973 in my 20th year. My public testimony is posted here: https://www.oberf.org/max_w_ste.htm Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1940's NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Suicide attempt. mom said she knew she had died and was going up into a heavenly area. How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain. I do not know the answer. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I do not know the answer. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I do not know the answer. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I do not know the answer. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I do not know the answer. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain. I do not know the answer. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Uncertain. I do not know the answer. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain I do not know the answer. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Mom said she was in heaven What emotions did you feel during the experience? I do not know the answer. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. Two angels stopped mom. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant. Mom had been very active in her church for years before a difficult divorce and then being alone. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian. Looking back I can see now that she would get out and go to a church or group but ultimately, never really fit in. When TV began to offer more, she would 'go to church' anytime she wanted by watching charismatic, independent type religious programs. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience these are questions. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. Two angels met mom and sent her back Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain. During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes. Mom was told she had to return to have three more children During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Uncertain these are questions I do not know the answer to ... some I had to check something to process the form During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain these are questions I do not know the answer to ... some I had to check something to process the form Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes had to return to fulfill the purpose of bearing 3 more children one of which would be taken before the Most High During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes that her purpose was not completed and she had to return During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Unknown. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Uncertain. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Uncertain. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Uncertain. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Unknown. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes, she apparently never talked about her expeience until she told me over 50 years later. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events t these are questions. She didn't tell me. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Unknown. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Uncertain. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain . What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain This is a submission concerning what my now deceased mom told me late in her life Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Uncertain Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Unknown.
